q: What does the Pune rubber component cluster use in energy, and what do auto OEMs ask?
title: Pune rubber parts makers: energy for OEMs
short: Your power bills answer most of an OEM's carbon request. Pune's 80 or so rubber component units used 42.3 million kWh, 536 t of LDO and 75 t of diesel in 2017-18, so electricity is 87% of their energy and about 94% of their CO2. Add your parts output and you have a per kg figure.
audience: Seal, hose, bush and anti-vibration part makers in Pimpri Chinchwad, Chakan, Sanaswadi and Ranjangaon

ul: About 80 units: 25 micro (20 to 100 t of raw material a year), 45 small (100 to 500 t), 10 medium (500 to 1,000 t).
The 10 medium units use 59% of the energy; a typical one uses 2.4 million kWh a year.
Some units burn LDO in boilers for autoclave curing steam; diesel only for standby generators.
Natural rubber is 25 to 40% of raw material; synthetic rubbers such as NBR and EPDM are largely imported.
Scope 1 and 2 for your plant, for a stated year.
Energy by type: kWh, litres or tonnes of fuel.
Often a per part or per kg figure for what you supply them.
Sometimes raw material footprints, which you get from your rubber suppliers.

ol: Twelve months of kWh from bills, LDO and diesel from invoices.
Divide by kg of compound processed or kg of parts dispatched; say which.
Allocate to one OEM by its share of your kg, unless a press line runs only its parts.

p: Servo drives on injection moulding machines save 20 to 30% of their power. Better insulation on heated platens and thyristor heater control also help. On 94% grid CO2, these show up in the next OEM figure.

example.title: Cluster and a medium unit (estimate)
lines: Electricity: 42.3 million kWh x 0.675 = 28,553 t CO2
Total about 30,500 t; power is 94% of it
Medium unit: 2.4 million kWh x 0.675 = 1,620 t CO2 a year from power
example.note: From the TERI energy profile of the Pune rubber cluster (2017-18) with IPCC 2006 defaults for diesel oils and the CEA FY 2025-26 grid factor.

senseible: Senseible builds supplier evidence from your bills and fuel invoices, with the factor on every line, so the figure you send an OEM can be checked.
